title: Materialize provider-specific current-host inference pre-admission without reopening global capability closure
decisions: Optional provider absence does not fail global FA3 current-host conformance.
The collector is read-only and must not install, download or mutate provider runtimes.
Provider import/distribution presence is discovery evidence only, never runtime admission.
OpenVINO and ONNX Runtime may perform isolated CPU smoke tests when already installed; a CPU smoke is component evidence, not Model Router production-route evidence.
Any accelerated execution path requires a DEVICE-bound compatible backend and fresh HRB authorization/lease; no accelerator runtime PASS is inferred from CUDA/EP/provider discovery.
TensorRT and TensorRT-RTX cannot receive current-host runtime PASS without real accelerator E2E bound to HRB evidence.
Full production provider promotion additionally requires canonical Model Router -> provider adapter -> backend execution evidence; the currently open Model Router PR is not assumed merged.
This implementation projection does not reopen or alter the proven global 429/429 capability closure.
